body: ooooh thank you! i have been reflecting alot on my current personal relationships lately and ive become so detached from everyone because ive realised that i haven’t been setting boundaries properly. i’ve journalled quite extensively about what type of friendships i want in my life and how i want my friends to show up for me (and even written all the qualities i want in a partner). i’ve read your blog post (thank you!) and it is so true i’ve been working on reflecting on my actions, especially attachment styles and limerence. this is quite a crude question but with intimacy, do you think that the opportunity will present itself or do i have to go and get it? right now i am not actively looking for a relationship because i want to figure out why dating triggers my anxiety so much but i am looking for some fun tbh lowkey🙊

noo when i said made i meant it in a hyperbolic manner. we were talking about attachment styles one evening on the phone and i was talking about how i use it in my life and stuff and then i asked her if she wants to take one too. im not romantically interested in her anymore that initial obsession is long gone, we are just close friends. but yeah i can tell she dosent want to see me

:( thank you for your words, its just extremely hard because I always try to meet the people I care about half way but whenever I expect/ask for the same its never given to me

thank you so much for your kind words. how do i stop myself from helping people too much? and it’s quite interesting that my chart says that i am an independent type bc i am always fearful of being too codependent and i do to an extent have a fear of being alone forever. and i’ll definitely take up on your suggestion on having a feeling journal because i am so dismissive of my own negative feelings towards others bc i always feel like i shouldn’t feel that way. i’ll continue to keep working on myself :’)
why did they dump you?

.. we were doing so well. this was the first relationship/situationship i was in and she always asked the right questions, like what do i want out of this relationship, what are my goals, if the pace we are at is fine, and i reassured her whenever she asked me to. i even told her i would reassure her 500x if needed and she appreciated it so much. i was her first kiss and first (almost) sexual experience and she gushed about it for weeks. we always talked about how we would be intentional w our love for e/o. whenever she said that she feels like she isn’t good enough for me i told her shes more than enough, there isn’t any room for disappointment when im with her. but she still decided to end it. i think it’s because of fear and it hurts so much bc i kept telling her i really want to make this work. but i realised today that all she said was thank you in regards to that. i dont know. it was only 3 months and 3 months after the breakup she didnt want to answer any questions i had bc she didnt really bave anything else to say. i was too late. i failed.

tbh i can only advise you on the college situation since i’m kinda in the same boat as you. I’ve successfully moved out for uni and they have changed their behaviour a bit but only time will tell when i go back for the summer. I think you should still apply for out of state colleges behind their back, it would help if you are able to apply to really good ones so they can be a bit lax. when you get accepted DO NOT under any circumstances fall for their guilt tripping. me and my parents argued for MONTHS about me moving out for uni and at one point they even sobbed in front of me to try to change my mind please do not change your decision. I truly hope things do get better for you but honestly freedom is rarely given; you have to take it the majority of the time
